image.name: msedge
image.description: [Microsoft Edge](https://www.microsoft.com/edge) is a cross-platform web browser developed by Microsoft and based on Chromium.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Clean up Singletons if container is shut down while windows are open.

env_vars.name: EDGE_CLI
env_vars.desc: Specify one or multiple Chromium CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP Edge desktop gui, needs to be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is required for Edge to launch and function.

image.title: Msedge
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* http://yourhost:3000/
* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  msedge:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/msedge:latest
    container_name: msedge
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - EDGE_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=msedge \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e EDGE_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/msedge:latest
